title: Individual characterization of the structure and morphometry of osteogenic cells before and after radiation in patients with head and neck cancer: A contribution to bone physiologic healing processes in compromised patients
summary: The aim of the present study is to take samples from the jawbone of patients before planned radiation as part of the tooth rehabilitation required by guidelines, and after therapy either after 3 or 6 months. The removed cells are examined in the laboratory. At the same time, the amount of the possible radiation dose on the area of ​​the jawbone to be treated should be recorded radiologically and placed in the clinical context. For this purpose, clinical and radiological parameters are documented in the course of the dental implantological rehabilitation using a standard protocol.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma that has undergone surgery and/or radiation.
Exclusion criteria:
<18 years old, smoker
